{
  "schema": "semio.acceptance.goal-plan/v1",
  "id": "repo-goal-2026-09",
  "title": { "en": "Repository goal: os s frontend, hub backend, collaboration, AI over the semio MCP", "de": "Repository-Ziel: os-s-Oberfläche, Hub-Backend, Zusammenarbeit, KI über das semio-MCP" },
  "outcomes": [
    { "id": "1", "title": { "en": "Working os s frontend with all plugins and artifacts", "de": "Funktionierende os-s-Oberfläche mit allen Plugins und Artefakten" } },
    { "id": "2", "title": { "en": "Working hub server backend: database, presence, authentication, observability", "de": "Funktionierendes Hub-Server-Backend: Datenbank, Präsenz, Authentifizierung, Beobachtbarkeit" } },
    { "id": "3", "title": { "en": "Collaboration between users over the hub in the React and wgpu shells", "de": "Zusammenarbeit zwischen Nutzern über den Hub in der React- und der wgpu-Shell" } },
    { "id": "4", "title": { "en": "AI integration for users over the semio MCP", "de": "KI-Integration für Nutzer über das semio-MCP" } },
    { "id": "5", "title": { "en": "Cross-cutting AGENTS.md requirements", "de": "Übergreifende AGENTS.md-Anforderungen" } }
  ],
  "providers": {
    "hub": { "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8787/", "readyPath": "/readyz", "readyBoundMs": 3600000, "project": "os-hub", "target": "local-hub-owner", "args": ["http://127.0.0.1:8787"], "requires": [], "adminCapability": ".🧬semio/🌐hub/hub-dev/admin-capability.json" },
    "serve": { "url": "http://127.0.0.1:6071/", "readyPath": "/", "readyBoundMs": 600000, "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "serve-hold", "args": ["--serve", "http://127.0.0.1:6071/", "--hub", "{hub}"], "requires": ["hub"] },
    "localServe": { "url": "http://127.0.0.1:6070/", "readyPath": "/", "readyBoundMs": 600000, "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "serve-hold", "args": ["--serve", "http://127.0.0.1:6070/"], "requires": [] }
  },
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "hub-fresh",
      "title": { "en": "The hub under test runs the current tree", "de": "Der geprüfte Hub läuft auf dem aktuellen Stand" },
      "mode": "serial",
      "gatesRest": true,
      "checks": [
        { "id": "hub-build-freshness", "title": { "en": "Hub build matches the source tree", "de": "Hub-Build entspricht dem Quellstand" }, "criteria": ["1.3", "2.5"], "project": "os-hub-ts", "target": "hub-freshness", "args": ["--hub", "{hub}"], "requires": ["hub"], "browsers": 0 }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "hub-laws",
      "title": { "en": "Hub launch check and full hub law suite", "de": "Hub-Startprüfung und vollständige Hub-Gesetzessuite" },
      "mode": "serial",
      "gatesRest": true,
      "checks": [
        { "id": "hub-launch", "title": { "en": "Local bootstrap launch check", "de": "Prüfung des lokalen Bootstrap-Starts" }, "criteria": ["2.1"], "project": "os-hub", "target": "local-bootstrap-launch-check", "args": [], "requires": [], "browsers": 0 },
        { "id": "hub-laws-all-features", "title": { "en": "Hub and db laws, all features", "de": "Hub- und DB-Gesetze, alle Features" }, "criteria": ["2.2", "2.3"], "project": "os-hub", "target": "test-all-features", "args": [], "requires": ["backends"], "browsers": 0 },
        {"id":"hub-hostile-input","title":{"en":"The hub survives hostile and generated input on every route and socket","de":"Der Hub übersteht feindliche und generierte Eingaben auf jeder Route und jedem Socket"},"criteria":["2.13"],"project":"os-hub","target":"hostile-input-check","args":["--locale","en"],"requires":[],"browsers":0}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "backends-and-boot",
      "title": { "en": "Group A: postgres and neo4j documents, cold boot of s", "de": "Gruppe A: Dokumente auf postgres und neo4j, Kaltstart von s" },
      "mode": "parallel",
      "gatesRest": false,
      "checks": [
        { "id": "two-client-postgres", "title": { "en": "Two clients on one postgres document", "de": "Zwei Clients auf einem postgres-Dokument" }, "criteria": ["2.4", "2.10"], "project": "os-hub-ts", "target": "two-client-e2e", "args": ["postgres"], "env": { "OS_HUB_BINARY": "{hubBinary}" }, "requires": ["backends"], "browsers": 0 },
        { "id": "document-growth-postgres", "title": { "en": "Document growth on postgres", "de": "Dokumentwachstum auf postgres" }, "criteria": ["2.4"], "project": "os-hub-ts", "target": "document-growth-e2e", "args": ["postgres"], "env": { "OS_HUB_BINARY": "{hubBinary}" }, "requires": ["backends"], "browsers": 0 },
        { "id": "two-client-neo4j", "title": { "en": "Two clients on one neo4j document", "de": "Zwei Clients auf einem neo4j-Dokument" }, "criteria": ["2.4", "2.10"], "project": "os-hub-ts", "target": "two-client-e2e", "args": ["neo4j"], "env": { "OS_HUB_BINARY": "{hubBinary}" }, "requires": ["backends"], "browsers": 0 },
        { "id": "document-growth-neo4j", "title": { "en": "Document growth on neo4j", "de": "Dokumentwachstum auf neo4j" }, "criteria": ["2.4"], "project": "os-hub-ts", "target": "document-growth-e2e", "args": ["neo4j"], "env": { "OS_HUB_BINARY": "{hubBinary}" }, "requires": ["backends"], "browsers": 0 },
        { "id": "s-cold-boot", "title": { "en": "Cold boot of the s React shell", "de": "Kaltstart der s-React-Shell" }, "criteria": ["1.1"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "cold-boot-check-s", "args": [], "requires": [], "browsers": 1 }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "frontend",
      "title": { "en": "Group B: every kind in s, en and de, accessibility, capability texts", "de": "Gruppe B: jede Art in s, en und de, Barrierefreiheit, Fähigkeitstexte" },
      "mode": "parallel",
      "gatesRest": false,
      "checks": [
        { "id": "program-matrix-en", "title": { "en": "Editor and viewer matrix, English", "de": "Editor- und Betrachtermatrix, Englisch" }, "criteria": ["1.1", "1.6", "5.2"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "program-matrix", "args": ["--serve", "{localServe}", "--tag", "goal-en", "--locale", "en", "--roles", "editor,viewer"], "requires": ["localServe"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "program-matrix-de", "title": { "en": "Editor and viewer matrix, German", "de": "Editor- und Betrachtermatrix, Deutsch" }, "criteria": ["1.6", "5.2"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "program-matrix", "args": ["--serve", "{localServe}", "--tag", "goal-de", "--locale", "de", "--roles", "editor,viewer"], "requires": ["localServe"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "foreign-kind", "title": { "en": "Hub documents created, edited, undone and redone per kind", "de": "Hub-Dokumente je Art angelegt, bearbeitet, rückgängig gemacht und wiederholt" }, "criteria": ["1.4", "1.5"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "s-host-foreign-kind-s", "args": ["{serve}", "--tag", "goal"], "requires": ["serve"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "pinch-a11y", "title": { "en": "Pinch, diagram contrast and accessibility", "de": "Pinch-Geste, Diagrammkontrast und Barrierefreiheit" }, "criteria": ["5.3"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "s-host-pinch-diagram-contrast-s", "args": ["{serve}", "--tag", "goal"], "requires": ["serve"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "connection-budget", "title": { "en": "One stream channel and no idle HTTP holds per origin", "de": "Ein Stromkanal und keine untätig gehaltenen HTTP-Verbindungen je Ursprung" }, "criteria": ["1.1", "5.6"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "connection-budget", "args": ["{serve}"], "requires": ["serve"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "tool-run-matrix-en", "title": { "en": "Every tool runs, pauses, commits as declared, undoes and aborts, English", "de": "Jedes Werkzeug läuft, pausiert, schreibt wie deklariert, lässt sich rückgängig machen und abbrechen, Englisch" }, "criteria": ["5.4", "1.5"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "tool-run-matrix", "args": ["--serve", "{localServe}", "--tag", "goal-en", "--locale", "en"], "requires": ["localServe"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "tool-run-matrix-de", "title": { "en": "Tool runs, German", "de": "Werkzeugläufe, Deutsch" }, "criteria": ["5.4", "5.2"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "tool-run-matrix", "args": ["--serve", "{localServe}", "--tag", "goal-de", "--locale", "de"], "requires": ["localServe"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "hub-document-sweep-en", "title": { "en": "Every hub-creatable kind created, opened and round-tripped inside s, English", "de": "Jede auf dem Hub anlegbare Art in s angelegt, geöffnet und hin und zurück bearbeitet, Englisch" }, "criteria": ["1.4", "1.5", "1.2"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "hub-document-sweep", "args": ["--serve", "{serve}", "--hub", "{hub}", "--tag", "goal-en", "--locale", "en"], "env": { "OS_HUB_PROBE_EMAIL": "{user1Email}", "OS_HUB_PROBE_PASSWORD": "{user1Password}" }, "requires": ["hub", "serve"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "hub-document-sweep-de", "title": { "en": "Every hub-creatable kind inside s, German", "de": "Jede auf dem Hub anlegbare Art in s, Deutsch" }, "criteria": ["1.4", "5.2"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "hub-document-sweep", "args": ["--serve", "{serve}", "--hub", "{hub}", "--tag", "goal-de", "--locale", "de"], "env": { "OS_HUB_PROBE_EMAIL": "{user1Email}", "OS_HUB_PROBE_PASSWORD": "{user1Password}" }, "requires": ["hub", "serve"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "idle-budget", "title": { "en": "Every program idles below one frame per second", "de": "Jedes Programm bleibt im Leerlauf unter einem Bild pro Sekunde" }, "criteria": ["5.4"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "idle-budget", "args": ["{localServe}"], "requires": ["localServe"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "memory-soak", "title": { "en": "Ten open editors hold their memory for 30 minutes", "de": "Zehn offene Editoren halten ihren Speicher 30 Minuten lang" }, "criteria": ["5.4"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "memory-soak", "args": ["{localServe}"], "requires": ["localServe"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "capability-audit", "title": { "en": "Every capability carries en and de descriptions", "de": "Jede Fähigkeit trägt Beschreibungen auf Englisch und Deutsch" }, "criteria": ["4.2"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-mcp-rs", "target": "capability-audit-check", "args": [], "requires": [], "browsers": 0 },
        {"id":"boot-budget","title":{"en":"Boot budget (s React shell)","de":"Startbudget (s-React-Shell)"},"criteria":["1.1","5.4"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-os-dev","target":"boot-budget","args":["--serve","{localServe}","--locale","en","--tag","goal"],"requires":["localServe"],"browsers":1},
        {"id":"interaction-latency","title":{"en":"Typing, drag and hover latency within budget (s React shell)","de":"Tipp-, Zieh- und Hover-Latenz im Budget (s-React-Shell)"},"criteria":["1.1","5.4"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-os-dev","target":"interaction-latency","args":["{localServe}","--tag","goal"],"requires":["localServe"],"browsers":1}
      ]
    },
    { "id": "frontend-journeys", "title": {"en":"Group B2: export and import per kind, Home studio catalog, en and de","de":"Gruppe B2: Export und Import pro Art, Home-Studiokatalog, en und de"}, "mode": "parallel", "gatesRest": false, "checks": [
        {"id":"io-matrix-en","title":{"en":"Export and import through s, per kind, English","de":"Export und Import über s, pro Art, Englisch"},"criteria":["1.7","1.8"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-os-dev","target":"io-matrix","args":["--serve","{localServe}","--locale","en","--tag","goal-en"],"requires":["localServe"],"browsers":1},
        {"id":"io-matrix-de","title":{"en":"Export and import through s, per kind, German","de":"Export und Import über s, pro Art, Deutsch"},"criteria":["1.7","1.8","5.2"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-os-dev","target":"io-matrix","args":["--serve","{localServe}","--locale","de","--tag","goal-de"],"requires":["localServe"],"browsers":1},
        {"id":"home-e2e-en","title":{"en":"Home studio catalog end to end","de":"Home-Studiokatalog Ende zu Ende"},"criteria":["1.1"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-os-dev","target":"verify-home","args":["--serve","{localServe}","--locale","en"],"requires":["localServe"],"browsers":1},
        {"id":"home-e2e-de","title":{"en":"Home studio catalog end to end","de":"Home-Studiokatalog Ende zu Ende"},"criteria":["1.1","5.2"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-os-dev","target":"verify-home","args":["--serve","{localServe}","--locale","de"],"requires":["localServe"],"browsers":1},
        {"id":"home-e2e-hub-en","title":{"en":"Home studio catalog end to end with a hub space","de":"Home-Studiokatalog Ende zu Ende mit Hub-Raum"},"criteria":["1.1","1.4"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-os-dev","target":"verify-home","args":["--serve","{serve}","--hub","{hub}","--locale","en"],"env":{"OS_HUB_PROBE_EMAIL":"{user1Email}","OS_HUB_PROBE_PASSWORD":"{user1Password}"},"requires":["serve","hub"],"browsers":1}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "collaboration-react",
      "title": { "en": "Two humans in the React shell", "de": "Zwei Menschen in der React-Shell" },
      "mode": "serial",
      "gatesRest": false,
      "checks": [
        { "id": "two-human-en", "title": { "en": "Two browser users on one hub, every creatable kind, English", "de": "Zwei Browser-Nutzer auf einem Hub, jede anlegbare Art, Englisch" }, "criteria": ["3.1", "3.4", "3.9", "3.11"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "two-human", "args": ["--hub", "{hub}", "--serve", "{serve}", "--locale", "en", "--max-create-to-mounted-ms", "120000", "--max-open-to-mounted-ms", "30000"], "env": { "SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_EMAIL": "{user1Email}", "SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_PASSWORD": "{user1Password}", "SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_EMAIL": "{user2Email}", "SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_PASSWORD": "{user2Password}" }, "requires": ["hub", "serve"], "browsers": 2 },
        { "id": "two-human-de", "title": { "en": "Two browser users on one hub, German", "de": "Zwei Browser-Nutzer auf einem Hub, Deutsch" }, "criteria": ["3.1", "5.2"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-dev", "target": "two-human", "args": ["--hub", "{hub}", "--serve", "{serve}", "--locale", "de", "--max-create-to-mounted-ms", "120000", "--max-open-to-mounted-ms", "30000"], "env": { "SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_EMAIL": "{user1Email}", "SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_PASSWORD": "{user1Password}", "SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_EMAIL": "{user2Email}", "SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_PASSWORD": "{user2Password}" }, "requires": ["hub", "serve"], "browsers": 2 },
        { "id": "react-collaboration-e2e-en", "title": { "en": "React two-human collaboration over the hub", "de": "Zusammenarbeit zweier Menschen in React über den Hub" }, "criteria": ["3.1", "3.2", "3.3", "3.4", "3.9", "3.10", "5.6"], "project": "os-hub", "target": "dev-collaboration", "args": ["--hub", "{hub}", "--locale", "en"], "env": { "S_COLLAB_HUB_URL": "{hub}", "S_COLLAB_USER1_PASSWORD": "{user1Password}", "S_COLLAB_USER2_PASSWORD": "{user2Password}", "S_COLLAB_HUB_ADMIN_CAPABILITY_FILE": "{hubAdminCapability}" }, "requires": ["hub", "backends", "hubAdmin"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "react-collaboration-e2e-de", "title": { "en": "React two-human collaboration over the hub, German", "de": "Zusammenarbeit zweier Menschen in React über den Hub, Deutsch" }, "criteria": ["3.1", "3.9", "3.10", "5.2", "5.6"], "project": "os-hub", "target": "dev-collaboration", "args": ["--hub", "{hub}", "--locale", "de"], "env": { "S_COLLAB_HUB_URL": "{hub}", "S_COLLAB_USER1_PASSWORD": "{user1Password}", "S_COLLAB_USER2_PASSWORD": "{user2Password}", "S_COLLAB_HUB_ADMIN_CAPABILITY_FILE": "{hubAdminCapability}" }, "requires": ["hub", "backends", "hubAdmin"], "browsers": 1 },
        {"id":"two-human-viewer","title":{"en":"Two humans: viewer role is read-only","de":"Zwei Personen: Betrachterrolle ist schreibgeschützt"},"criteria":["3.4"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-os-dev","target":"two-human-viewer","args":["--hub","{hub}","--serve","{serve}","--locale","en","--admin-capability","{hubAdminCapability}"],"env":{"SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_EMAIL":"{user1Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_PASSWORD":"{user1Password}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_EMAIL":"{user2Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_PASSWORD":"{user2Password}"},"requires":["hub","serve","hubAdmin"],"browsers":1},
        {"id":"two-human-cross-undo","title":{"en":"Two humans: each undo reverts only its own edits","de":"Zwei Personen: jedes Rückgängig nimmt nur eigene Änderungen zurück"},"criteria":["3.11"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-os-dev","target":"two-human-cross-undo","args":["--hub","{hub}","--serve","{serve}","--locale","en","--admin-capability","{hubAdminCapability}"],"env":{"SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_EMAIL":"{user1Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_PASSWORD":"{user1Password}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_EMAIL":"{user2Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_PASSWORD":"{user2Password}"},"requires":["hub","serve","hubAdmin"],"browsers":1}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "collaboration-wgpu-and-agents",
      "title": { "en": "Group C: wgpu shells and agents on the hub", "de": "Gruppe C: wgpu-Shells und Agenten auf dem Hub" },
      "mode": "parallel",
      "gatesRest": false,
      "checks": [
        { "id": "wgpu-live-collaboration", "title": { "en": "Two native wgpu shells collaborate", "de": "Zwei native wgpu-Shells arbeiten zusammen" }, "criteria": ["3.5"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-renderer-wgpu", "target": "hub-live-collaboration-check", "args": [], "env": { "SEMIO_HUB_LIVE_ORIGIN": "{hub}", "SEMIO_HUB_LIVE_EMAIL": "{user1Email}", "SEMIO_HUB_LIVE_PASSWORD": "{user1Password}", "SEMIO_HUB_LIVE_PEER_EMAIL": "{user2Email}", "SEMIO_HUB_LIVE_PEER_PASSWORD": "{user2Password}" }, "requires": ["hub"], "browsers": 0 },
        { "id": "wgpu-live-journey", "title": { "en": "wgpu shell hub journey", "de": "Hub-Weg der wgpu-Shell" }, "criteria": ["3.2"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-renderer-wgpu", "target": "hub-live-journey-check", "args": [], "env": { "SEMIO_HUB_LIVE_ORIGIN": "{hub}", "SEMIO_HUB_LIVE_EMAIL": "{user1Email}", "SEMIO_HUB_LIVE_PASSWORD": "{user1Password}" }, "requires": ["hub"], "browsers": 0 },
        { "id": "mcp-hub-agent-participant", "title": { "en": "A human sees an agent's edit live", "de": "Ein Mensch sieht die Bearbeitung eines Agenten live" }, "criteria": ["3.12"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-mcp-rs", "target": "hub-agent-participant-check", "args": [], "env": { "OS_MCP_HUB_ORIGIN": "{hub}", "OS_MCP_HUB_EMAIL": "{user1Email}", "OS_MCP_HUB_PASSWORD": "{user1Password}" }, "requires": ["hub"], "browsers": 1 },
        { "id": "mcp-agent-reply", "title": { "en": "Agent reply reaches the shell", "de": "Antwort des Agenten erreicht die Shell" }, "criteria": ["4.7"], "project": "@semio-tech/framework-os-mcp-rs", "target": "agent-reply-check", "args": [], "env": { "S_OS_MCP_LIVE_SHELL_URL": "{serve}" }, "requires": ["serve"], "browsers": 1 },
        {"id":"wgpu-collaboration-wasm32-en","title":{"en":"wgpu wasm32 ↔ wasm32 collaboration over the hub","de":"wgpu-wasm32 ↔ wasm32-Zusammenarbeit über den Hub"},"criteria":["3.2","3.7","3.9","3.10"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-renderer-wgpu","target":"hub-collaboration-acceptance","args":["--journey","wasm32","--hub","{hub}","--locale","en"],"env":{"SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_EMAIL":"{user1Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_PASSWORD":"{user1Password}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_EMAIL":"{user2Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_PASSWORD":"{user2Password}"},"requires":["hub"],"browsers":1},
        {"id":"wgpu-collaboration-wasm32-de","title":{"en":"wgpu wasm32 ↔ wasm32 collaboration over the hub","de":"wgpu-wasm32 ↔ wasm32-Zusammenarbeit über den Hub"},"criteria":["3.2","3.7","3.9","3.10","5.2"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-renderer-wgpu","target":"hub-collaboration-acceptance","args":["--journey","wasm32","--hub","{hub}","--locale","de"],"env":{"SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_EMAIL":"{user1Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_PASSWORD":"{user1Password}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_EMAIL":"{user2Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_PASSWORD":"{user2Password}"},"requires":["hub"],"browsers":1},
        {"id":"wgpu-collaboration-wasm32-react-en","title":{"en":"wgpu wasm32 ↔ React collaboration","de":"Zusammenarbeit wgpu-wasm32 ↔ React"},"criteria":["3.8"],"project":"@semio-tech/framework-renderer-wgpu","target":"hub-collaboration-acceptance","args":["--journey","wasm32-react","--hub","{hub}","--locale","en","--react-serve","{localServe}"],"env":{"SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_EMAIL":"{user1Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER1_PASSWORD":"{user1Password}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_EMAIL":"{user2Email}","SEMIO_TWO_HUMAN_USER2_PASSWORD":"{user2Password}"},"requires":["hub","localServe"],"browsers":1},
